methodologyNotes: Covers dedicated handheld game consoles built primarily for playing retro/classic games, whether via software emulation (Linux or Android firmware), officially licensed cartridges, or FPGA hardware. Includes clamshell, vertical, and horizontal form factors sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes first-party current-gen consoles (Switch, Steam Deck-class Windows PCs), phone-clip controllers, and DIY/kit-only devices. Price is manufacturer MSRP (or typical retail for direct-from-brand imports) of the base configuration in USD. screenSizeIn is display diagonal in inches. screenResolution is native panel pixels written as width x height (NOT upscaled/integer-scaled output). panelType is an enum: IPS, OLED, AMOLED, TFT-LCD, or FPGA-driven. refreshRateHz is the panel refresh rate in Hz. soc is the manufacturer-published system-on-chip / processor part name (verbatim), or the FPGA/none designation for hardware-based units. ramGb is system memory in gigabytes (0 for FPGA/cartridge devices without general RAM). internalStorageGb is built-in user storage of the base SKU in gigabytes, excluding microSD expansion (0 if the device ships with no onboard storage). batteryCapacityMah is rated battery capacity in mAh. batteryLifeHrs is the manufacturer-rated mixed-use battery life in hours; null if not disclosed. operatingSystem is an enum: Linux, Android (with version), or proprietary (FPGA/cartridge units with no general-purpose OS). weightGrams is device weight in grams. hasWifi is a boolean for built-in Wi-Fi.
